related_questions.question: What is UDCA used for?
related_questions.snippet: Ursodeoxycholic acid (UDCA), also known as ursodiol, has been used to treat liver disease for more than a hundred years. It was first employed in traditional Chinese medicine by herbalists and physicians alike. Before discovering its effectiveness in dissolving gallstones, its primary use was as a liver tonic.
